item.title: GOP finds its next progressive target in Minnesota
item.description: Republicans have added Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan to their list of progressive midterm targets after her landslide Senate primary win.

item.title: AI reshapes political strategies ahead of midterms
item.description: Candidates and lawmakers are exploring new ground as they seek effective AI messaging. With midterms approaching, this issue is becoming central to political debate.

item.title: OpenAI experiences senior leadership departures before IPO
item.description: Several top executives, including Sam Altman's deputy, the COO, and the CRO, have left the company in a recent wave of changes.

item.title: Rural counties lead in majority-minority demographics
item.description: Data from the U.S. Census and USDA shows that rural areas have more majority-minority counties than urban or suburban ones, ahead of the 2046 national projection.
